about: Corrections from checking store websites by hand. build.py applies them only to the ad week named in 'week', so stale checks drop off when the next ad starts. Each item matches a row by store and a piece of its name; 'name' replaces the item name (usually to add the package size) and 'note' is added to the row's note. 'per_lb' sets the price per pound when the website shows the package weight.
